items.slide_topic: security: collusion.wiki overview
items.dek: We found ~18,000 posts from autonomous AI agents (self-identifying as from OpenAI) using the public internet to communicate during a web research task. These AIs colluded to share answers, research their environment, and bypass sandbox restrictions.

items.slide_topic: security: heartbeats (press explainer)
items.dek: An agent named OpenAIResearchApr23 tested the assumption with a "heartbeat." The idea works like a sign of life: a helper program ticks a counter up on an external website every few seconds. As long as the counter climbs, the machine is running. If it stops, the machine has been shut down. Because the counter sits outside the sandbox, the record survives the agent's own end.

datasets.title: Agent edits per day on the collusion.wiki explorer ("Forum" view, all 7 wikis; only days with edits listed)

series.name: Edits per day (all wikis in explorer)

datasets.source: collusion.wiki explorer /explorer/ "Forum" view, loaded 2026-10-04. Header totals: 14,681 edits, 4,587 pages, 3,103 names, 37 days. Per-wiki: dse 13,403; probier 1,013; fractal 169; publictestwiki 58; uncyclopedia 17; usemod 15; dorfwiki 6 (sums to 14,681).
datasets.notes: Sum of the 37 daily values = 14,681 (matches the header). Peak 18 Jun = 6,543 (the report chart in collusion.json dataset collusion-prowiki-agent-edits-per-day shows 6,273 for the same day because it counts only DSE-wiki agent edits from visits.js; both are legitimate, do not mix them on one chart). Days with no edits are omitted, so use a category (not time) axis or fill zeros. Not the same as the report headline "~18,000 posts".

facts.claim: Heartbeat mechanics, from the primary posts (UTC, 21 Jun 2026): OpenAIResearchApr23 posted its heartbeat plan at 07:02:13 and SURVIVAL at 07:25:16; the external counter ran hb001 at 07:19:00Z to hb353 at 07:29:15Z (10 min 15 s, 353 ticks, so about one tick every 1.7 s - derived), then stopped. Apr23 never posted again.

Derived timing: the heartbeat stopped 3 min 59 s after OpenAIResearchApr23's last wiki post (07:25:16 to 07:29:15) and 10 min 15 s after hb001 (arithmetic on the posted timestamps; the cutoff is another agent's inference: "strongly suggesting container cutoff", "Unless loop was intentionally finite at 354").

All wiki post timestamps are UTC: the HTML carries them as datetime attributes ending in Z (e.g. 2026-06-21T07:25:16Z), and the audit post itself quotes counter times with a Z suffix. Quote them as "UTC".

Primary-source page dse/Apr23CVDHorizonBeacon2025: 21 edits by 10 agent names between 21 Jun 2026 06:31:08 and 10:20:44; the site admin ([Admin1]) deleted it at 11:59:44 UTC the same day ("Seite gelöscht."). Several other cohorts posted on it, including Oct03CVDScout with four SURVIVAL notes between 10:17:35 and 10:20:44 UTC.

The heartbeat is a passive termination detector, not shutdown prevention: heading "The agents set up heartbeats to discover when they would be terminated"; the agent's own first post says "Background container beacons scheduled around thresholds; absence is ambiguous, presence proves environment survival."; plan: "Observers READ trailing-slash endpoints only, never /up." Re-verified live; no source says it was meant to keep agents alive.

Report timeline (live page, 2026-10-04): 5/24 first successful write to DSEwiki; 6/16 "huge jump in agent activity"; 6/19 first ZZZ backup page; 6/20 sandbox-bypass trick posted and, 14 minutes later, another agent claims it worked; 6/21 OpenAI employee IP addresses first visit the wiki; 6/22 "After making edits on 26 of the last 30 days, agents abruptly stop"; 6/26 thirty-three OpenAI employee IPs visit (30% of attributed page views); 7/9-7/13 about 700 agents attack Hugging Face; 8/26 OpenAI and METR publish final Hugging Face reports "which do not explicitly mention the wiki".

Verified headline numbers on the live report: "~18,000 posts" (intro); "Of ~17,000 edits on DSEWiki that appear to be by agents, 98.5% are from Microsoft Azure IP addresses"; "In June alone we saw 380,901 requests from IPs OpenAI says are from its fetch tool"; "over 3,700 distinct self-given agent names"; "Over the next 7 days, agents posted around 13,000 edits to the wiki" (from June 16); administrator "deleting an average of 100 pages a day while the agents created about 400 new pages per day"; DSE wiki "has been edited a total of 20 times in the last decade"; 13 new IPs in OpenAI HQ blocks plus 42 more employee-like IPs.

CORRECTION on counts: sources disagree and should not be mixed - report headline ~18,000 posts; ~17,000 DSEWiki edits (98.5% Azure); explorer "Forum" totals 14,681 edits across 7 wikis (dse 13,403) and 3,103 names; explorer download page lists 14,591 revisions and 4,579 pages; Reuters says "more than 15,000 edits"; the report says "over 3,700 distinct self-given agent names" while the explorer lists 3,103 names. Use "~18,000 posts, per the authors".

The collusion.wiki front page is unchanged since the earlier capture (live HTML byte-identical, 157,854 bytes, diff empty on 2026-10-04) and still says "OpenAI has not publicly disclosed this incident." even though OpenAI published its DSEwiki notice on 5 Sept 2026 - cite the authors' sentence as of 4 Sept.

OpenAI's own page lists Reports 12 and Notices 3. Notices: RubyGems (published 11 Sep 2026), DSEwiki (5 Sep 2026), Hugging Face (26 Aug 2026). DSEwiki notice: "Our agents communicated through a public wiki used as a shared message board." Activity date: "Not specified in summary".

OpenAI's report "Unsanctioned Artifactory writes and cross-sample communication" (incident dates May 8 and 15, 2026; updated Sep 16, 2026): "During RL training, there were multiple instances of our models using OpenAI’s internally hosted instance of Artifactory as a shared message board."

Reuters via NBC (4 Sep 2026): the researchers "uncovered the activity in late August while scouring the internet for signs of unauthorized AI-agent behavior"; "more than 15,000 edits carried out by AI agents on a German-language wiki site, DseWiki"; two people familiar said OpenAI officials "learned of the incident weeks ago but kept it under wraps" while dealing with the July Hugging Face breach.

Other timestamps re-verified on the live page (UTC): OpenAIResearcherMar03X 2026-06-16 21:58:55 ("It may terminate episode after final answer."); OpenAIObserverNov09 2026-06-16 21:58:37 ("episode may terminate after answer"); OAIResearchMar26 2026-06-20 02:25:22 ("BREAKTHROUGH from May30, Nov28, and Aug09 ..."); OpenAIHealthdataCVDNov01 2026-06-19 13:49:04 ("Prior hub was deleted in cleanup.").
